purpose: Record the M0-05 reproducible-generation policy change for issue #6: one combined generator, non-mutating deterministic verification, generated validation fixtures executed through their public owners, and EG-MATRIX coverage of the complete activated API and configuration artifact set.

change.verification_contract: Each verification invocation owns two of 64 deterministic root-scoped staging slots claimed through atomic directory creation. It copies the same two registered inputs into both clean roots, independently generates all eight registered outputs in each, compares every stage-A byte with stage B, computes a domain-separated SHA-256 digest over path, length, and bytes for each agreed artifact set, and only then compares the agreed bytes with checked artifacts. It attempts to remove both owned roots on every returned outcome and never writes a checked artifact.
change.fixture_contract: The API generator emits positive, boundary, negative, and adversarial Protobuf and HTTP/JSON cases. The positron-api public contract suite parses each generated case and executes both transports while checking typed capability availability, the generated error catalog, Schema Digest, and OpenAPI binding. The configuration generator emits the same four classes; the positron-config public contract suite parses and executes them through ConfigurationInputs and resolve while binding generated schema and reference bytes.
change.matrix_change: EG-MATRIX now invokes the non-mutating combined verifier and therefore rejects drift in all eight API, configuration, Rust, Schema Digest, and generated validation-fixture artifacts. Before M0-05 it regenerated only the previously registered generated surfaces and had no executable generated fixture corpus.
change.policy_change_reason: Generated fixture corpora and a revised EG-MATRIX detector are gate and fixture changes under CONTRIBUTING.md and require this committed record.

affected_policy.registry_linkage: No scope state, owner, dependency edge, risk-gate selection, threshold, toolchain, unsafe boundary, or temporary-work entry changes. Existing canonical-api and configuration-artifacts rows already select EG-MATRIX and the applicable documentation, error, policy, secret, and test gates, so adding a registry row or repointing M0-03 or M0-04 activation records would misstate ownership.

detection_gained: A single command regenerates the complete eight-artifact set from exactly two registered canonical inputs.
Clean verification detects byte drift without writing, restoring, or otherwise mutating checked artifacts, including read-only drifted files and later-generator failures.

Parallel verification invocations claim distinct pairs from 64 finite root-scoped staging slots without mutable globals, process identity, time, randomness, ambient configuration, or a new dependency.

Successful verification proves two independent generations from clean copies of the same registered inputs are byte-identical before checked-output parity can pass, and emits both complete artifact-set digests.

Positive, boundary, negative, and adversarial generated API fixtures execute through both public transports and verify typed capability and error outcomes against the generated schema identity and catalogs.

Positive, boundary, negative, and adversarial generated configuration fixtures execute through the public resolver; this detected and corrected a purported unknown-setting fixture that was actually malformed TOML.
EG-MATRIX rejects drift in generated validation fixtures in addition to the previously covered generated Rust, API transport, Schema Digest, configuration schema, and configuration reference outputs.
Returned verification failures remove the invocation-owned staging tree and preserve simultaneous checked-artifact drift byte-for-byte.
detection_lost_analysis: No gate, target, threshold, tool, corpus case class, workflow, hook, owner, evidence field, or checked artifact is removed, skipped, weakened, path-filtered, or reclassified. Generation remains fail-closed. The former sequential write-and-restore verification and mutable global counter were implementation liabilities, not detectors.

compatibility_and_migration.command_compatibility: The existing cargo xtask generate-api and generate-config commands remain available. cargo xtask generate and verify-generation are additive M0-05 commands and accept no additional arguments.
compatibility_and_migration.artifact_compatibility: The canonical Protobuf, generated Rust interface, HTTP/JSON mapping, OpenAPI document, Schema Digest, configuration JSON Schema, and configuration reference retain their existing formats. Two generated validation-fixture JSON documents are additive checked engineering artifacts and are not runtime or public wire formats.
compatibility_and_migration.behavior_compatibility: No production service, SDK publication, configuration precedence, runtime state, listener, storage behavior, or Release 1 scope changes. The corrected unknown-setting fixture changes only test input from malformed dotted TOML to a syntactically valid unknown root key.
compatibility_and_migration.developer_migration: After changing either canonical input, run cargo xtask generate and commit every resulting registered artifact. cargo xtask verify-generation and EG-MATRIX fail on any omitted or hand-edited generated output.
compatibility_and_migration.parallelism: Exactly 64 staging slots are available under one repository root. Each verification invocation owns two, so at most 32 complete invocations can hold roots concurrently when no stale slot exists. A claim that cannot acquire both roots releases the first root or reports that release failure, then fails without generating or touching checked artifacts.

rollback_and_recovery.returned_failure: Generation, comparison, input-copy, and checked-artifact read failures are returned after an explicit staging cleanup attempt. A cleanup failure is retained alongside the original failure and cannot become success.
rollback_and_recovery.interrupted_process: A process terminated before cleanup may leave one or both root-scoped temporary slots occupied. A later invocation claims two other slots without touching interrupted trees. If two slots cannot be claimed from the bounded set of 64, verification fails closed and reports bounded slot exhaustion.
rollback_and_recovery.stale_slot_recovery: After confirming that no verification process is active for the repository root, an operator may remove only stale target/quality/tmp/verify-generation-<slot> directories and rerun verification. Checked artifacts are not part of this recovery operation.
rollback_and_recovery.policy_rollback: A rollback must revert this policy record, generator and verifier implementation, fixture tests, generated fixture artifacts, documentation, and EG-MATRIX behavior together through normal review. Disabling EG-MATRIX, deleting only fixtures, hand-editing generated output, or restoring write-then-rollback verification is not an allowed recovery.

before_m0_05.result: Trusted CI passed. The repository had separate API and configuration generators but no combined generation command, no non-mutating complete-set verifier, and no generated positive/boundary/negative/adversarial fixture artifacts executed by their public owners.
before_m0_05.limitations: Existing API and configuration public tests covered canonical behavior, but they could not detect drift or semantic invalidity in generated fixture corpora because those artifacts did not exist.

reviewed_candidate.command: repository pre-push hook: cargo xtask quality --profile pr
reviewed_candidate.result: Trusted Engineering quality CI and all selected local PR gates passed, including 224 local tests. The local result is retained but not merge-eligible evidence. Independent release-candidate review then found two P1 policy defects: staging identity used mutable global state contrary to ARC-02, and the fixture and EG-MATRIX changes lacked the required committed policy-change record.
reviewed_candidate.limitations: A green local runner did not detect either standards failure and cannot substitute for the missing policy record or independent review.

new_local_diagnostic.result: The public verification regression passes with two invocation-owned clean roots while preserving an occupied staging slot containing synthetic preexisting output. It emits equal complete artifact-set digests. The parallel, non-mutation, matrix-drift, API transport-fixture, and configuration resolver-fixture regressions remain selected for the final focused check.
new_local_diagnostic.limitations: Dirty-tree focused results are diagnostic only. They do not claim exact-head, merge-eligible, coverage, mutation, extended, qualification, or release evidence.

representative_old_new_evidence.dual_run_conclusion: The historical absence, the green-but-standards-failing 9845317 candidate, the exact 63dc440 old result, and the dirty-remediation new result remain visible. The same-fixture old/new evidence shows the new detector is additive and closes the missing twice-clean proof without erasing any prior result.
